bends.reason: B1, end flange on the near end of the lower (joggled) strip. Raw TOP shows a dense edge-on line at the strip end (darkness peak 160 vs plate ~75), and the overlay shows no flat material past the CAD outline. Raw SIDE shows the flange edge-on at the extreme, reaching past the strip away from the main plate, and FRONT shows its face-on band on the far side of the strip from the plate. Same direction as CAD, not reversed.

B2, long-edge flange on the near edge of the main plate. Raw TOP shows an edge-on line along the whole edge (peak 160 vs ~75). FRONT shows the face-on flange band on the strip side of the plate line, as in CAD. SIDE shows the edge-on segment at the extreme, and in the overlay ISO the scan fills the CAD flange band below the B2 line. Same direction, not reversed.

B3, flange on the free outer edge of the lower strip. Raw TOP shows an edge-on line along the edge (peak 164). Raw FRONT shows a dark edge-on lip with a rounded bend corner at the strip end, rising from the strip line away from the plate (rows 889-921, nothing on the plate side). CAD FRONT is partly hidden by labels, but the CAD SIDE band agrees. Same direction, not reversed.

B4, lower joggle bend (strip to wall). Raw FRONT shows the full Z-offset: strip, near-vertical wall about 78 px high (CAD about 84 px), then main plate, with a rounded corner at the strip/wall junction. Raw TOP shows the wall edge-on (peak 177). The strip sits on the opposite side of the plate from the tabs, as in CAD. Not reversed.

B5, outer (wall-to-foot) bend of the B2-side window tab; the CAD SIDE puts B5 at the wall tip and B6 at the hinge. Raw FRONT shows the tab wall block about 27 px from the plate (CAD about 26 px), and the overlay fills the CAD tab outline exactly. Unbent, the flap would stick out further as a straight strip. The raw SIDE post tip carries a short foot hooked outward toward the B2 edge, as in CAD. Not reversed.

B6, hinge bend of the B2-side window tab at the window's outer edge. The window is open in raw TOP, with a dense edge-on wall line on its outer edge (peak 172) and none on the inner cut edge. Raw SIDE shows the wall as a post perpendicular to the plate, on the side away from the strip, as in CAD. Not reversed.

B7, outer (wall-to-foot) bend of the B10-side window tab; the CAD SIDE puts B7 at the wall tip and B8 at the hinge. The tab wall height matches CAD (about 27 vs 26 px), and the overlay fills the CAD tab outline. The raw SIDE post tip carries a short foot hooked outward toward the B10 edge, mirroring the B2-side tab, as in CAD. Not reversed.

B8, hinge bend of the B10-side window tab at the window's outer edge. The window is open in raw TOP, with a dense edge-on wall line on its outer edge (peak 173) against at most 106 on the inner cut edge. Raw SIDE shows a post perpendicular to the plate, on the side away from the strip, as in CAD. Not reversed.

B9, end flange on the far end of the lower strip. Raw TOP shows an edge-on line at the strip end (peak 171). Raw SIDE shows the flange edge-on at the extreme, reaching past the strip away from the main plate, and FRONT shows the face-on band away from the plate. Matches CAD, not reversed.

B10, long-edge flange on the far edge of the main plate. Raw TOP shows an edge-on line along the whole edge (peak 167 vs ~75). FRONT shows the face-on flange band on the strip side of the plate line, as in CAD, and SIDE shows the edge-on segment at the extreme. Same direction as B2 and CAD, not reversed.

B11, upper joggle bend (wall to main plate). Raw FRONT shows a rounded corner where the near-vertical wall meets the main plate, completing the Z-offset. The overlay FRONT and ISO put the scan's wall and plate on the CAD B11 line. Offset direction matches CAD, not reversed.

B12, end flange on the free end of the main plate. Raw TOP shows an edge-on line at the CAD B12 position (peak 153), with no flat material past it except the two corner tabs that the CAD also has. Raw FRONT shows the edge-on flange inside the flange band on the strip side of the plate line, with its darkest columns (x 672-678) matching CAD and overlay, and nothing on the far side. Not reversed.
